title: DevBench — Inspect · Debug
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: Symbol table
items.text: Load a project's symbols, look up addresses, list functions and structs (MCP: amiga_load_symbols / amiga_lookup_symbol).

items.label: Disassembler
items.text: Disassemble memory, annotated with symbols when loaded (MCP: amiga_disassemble).

items.label: Crash report
items.text: Bridge crash handler: enable, check the last crash (MCP: amiga_last_crash).

items.label: Memory map
items.text: Exec memory lists: regions, attributes and free/used (MEMMAP).

items.label: Memory search / stack / diff
items.text: Search for a byte pattern, check a task's stack use, snapshot and diff memory.

items.label: Chip registers & audio
items.text: Classic custom-chip state (DMACON, INTENA…) and Paula channels — meaningful on 68k targets.

items.label: SnoopDos & chip logger
items.text: Trace OpenLibrary/Open/Lock… calls via SetFunction patches; log custom-chip writes.

items.label: Resources, profiler, pools
items.text: Per-client resource tracking, performance report and memory-pool tracking (MCP: amiga_list_resources / amiga_perf_report).
